audio_processing_contract.duration_authority: Finite positive duration measured from the downloaded audio; client/feed duration is advisory.
audio_processing_contract.source_unavailable: Audio HTTP404/410 fails this job once; it does not cancel the client request or other requests.
audio_processing_contract.resources_unavailable: Disk pressure or ENOSPC/EDQUOT pauses the same accepted job without consuming an attempt; completed checkpoints are preserved.
audio_processing_contract.language: Only explicitly configured unsupported languages are rejected. Automatic detection cannot guarantee recognition of unsupported spoken content.
audio_processing_contract.resume: Each claim has private immutable snapshots of completed chunks bound to the exact source SHA-256 and ASR settings.

rate_limits.isolation: Reads, submissions and cancellation use independent bounded buckets; exhausting reads or submissions does not disable authenticated cancellation.
